tools.name: geraet_wahl
tools.description: Welches Gerät löst mein Raumklima-Problem? — Choose a next step for heat, damp/mould, cold or stale air. For damp rooms, measure first, investigate damage and compare cold-room or laundry conditions before buying; floor area alone cannot size a dehumidifier. Same decision rules as the website.

tools.name: btu_empfehlung
tools.description: Empfohlene Kühlleistung (BTU) für einen Raum, mit passender Geräteklasse. — Recommended cooling capacity in BTU for a room, with the matching device class: how many BTU do I need for X m²? Same formula as the calculator on getecoback.com (340 BTU/m² × sun factor), for Germany and Europe.

tools.name: fensterabdichtung_laenge
tools.description: Benötigte Länge einer Fensterabdichtung für mobile Klimaanlagen aus den Flügelmaßen. — Required window-seal length for a portable air conditioner from the sash measurements (perimeter = 2×(width+height)), plus the off-the-shelf size that fits. Covers tilt-and-turn and roof windows.

tools.name: hitzewelle_vorschau
tools.description: Live-Hitzevorschau für Deutschland (nächste 3 Tage). — Live heatwave outlook for Germany: highest temperature over the next three days across Berlin, Frankfurt and Munich (open-meteo), flagged from 28 °C and 32 °C.

tools.name: klimaanlage_stromkosten
tools.description: Stromkosten eines Klimageräts. — Running cost of an air conditioner or any appliance: watts × hours × electricity price × compressor duty cycle. What does it cost to run per hour, per day, per month?

tools.name: heizleistung_watt
tools.description: Benötigte Heizleistung in Watt für einen Raum (Infrarot/Elektro). — Required heating power in watts for a room, from floor area and insulation standard (60/80/100 W/m² for new build, existing, old building), including running cost per full-load hour.

tools.name: taupunkt_lueften
tools.description: Taupunkt der Außenluft und die Antwort auf 'darf ich jetzt lüften?'. — Dew point of the outside air and whether opening the window right now would make a basement or damp room wetter (Magnus formula, walls counted 2 °C below room temperature).

tools.name: ratgeber_suche
tools.description: Durchsucht veröffentlichte Ratgeber mit lesbarer Textansicht. — Searches published guides with a readable Markdown mirror, returning title, canonical URL and task-specific summary. Every result can be passed to ratgeber_lesen.

tools.name: ratgeber_lesen
tools.description: Liest die redaktionelle Textansicht eines veröffentlichten Ratgebers. — Reads the cleaned Markdown of a published guide, with reviewed source links, assumptions and limits. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "geraet_wahl" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
